gloss: promissory note; bill of exchange; handprint

definitions.gloss: promissory note, bill of exchange, draft
definitions.explanation: A written promise to pay a specified sum of money at a future date, used in business transactions.
An impression or print made by a hand, often used for commemorative purposes or as souvenirs.

examples.japanese: {手形|てがた}で{支払|しはら}う。
{手形|てがた}が{不渡|ふわた}りになった。
{取引先|とりひきさき}から{手形|てがた}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I received a promissory note from a business partner.

examples.japanese: {力士|りきし}の{手形|てがた}をもらった。
examples.english: I got a sumo wrestler's handprint.

notes:
FINANCIAL TERM (sense 1):
{手形|てがた} is a negotiable instrument common in Japanese business, promising payment at a future date.

TYPES OF NOTES:
- {約束|やくそく}{手形|てがた}: Promissory note
- {為替|かわせ}{手形|てがた}: Bill of exchange

KEY EXPRESSIONS:
- {手形|てがた}を{振|ふ}り{出|だ}す: to issue a note
- {手形|てがた}を{割|わ}り{引|び}く: to discount a note
- {手形|てがた}が{落|お}ちる: note is honored (paid)
- {不渡|ふわた}り{手形|てがた}: Dishonored note

BUSINESS IMPORTANCE:
Two {不渡|ふわた}り (dishonored notes) within 6 months leads to {銀行|ぎんこう}{取引|とりひき}{停止|ていし} (bank transaction suspension), effectively meaning bankruptcy.

HANDPRINT (sense 2):
{手形|てがた} also means a handprint, commonly seen as:
- {力士|りきし}の{手形|てがた}: Sumo wrestler handprints (popular souvenirs)
- {赤|あか}ちゃんの{手形|てがた}: Baby handprints (keepsakes)

RELATED TERMS:
- {小切手|こぎって}: Check
- {現金|げんきん}: Cash
- {振込|ふりこみ}: Bank transfer
